note: Exposure triangle: aperture (depth of field), shutter speed (motion), ISO (noise).

aperture.name: f/1.4
aperture.description: very wide opening; very shallow depth of field, lots of light
aperture.prompt: very shallow depth of field, creamy blurred background

aperture.name: f/2
aperture.description: wide; shallow depth of field, good in low light
aperture.prompt: shallow depth of field, soft background

aperture.name: f/2.8
aperture.description: wide; shallow depth of field, standard pro zoom aperture
aperture.prompt: shallow depth of field, subject isolation

aperture.name: f/4
aperture.description: moderate; some background blur, a bit more in focus

aperture.name: f/5.6
aperture.description: moderate; most of a subject in focus, good lens sharpness
aperture.prompt: moderate depth of field, sharp subject

aperture.name: f/8
aperture.description: narrow; deep depth of field, usually the sharpest
aperture.prompt: deep depth of field, sharp from front to back

aperture.name: f/16
aperture.description: very narrow; maximum depth of field, less light
aperture.prompt: maximum depth of field, everything sharp, slight diffraction softness

shutter_speed.name: 1/100 sec
shutter_speed.description: sharp for walking, slight blur on fast movement
shutter_speed.prompt: natural motion, slight blur on fast limbs

shutter_speed.name: 1/15 sec
shutter_speed.description: strong blur; needs a tripod for still subjects

shutter_speed.name: 1/4 sec
shutter_speed.prompt: heavy motion blur, long exposure smear

iso.name: ISO 50
iso.description: cleanest image, needs lots of light

iso.name: ISO 100
iso.description: clean, base sensitivity for bright light

iso.name: ISO 800
iso.description: noticeable noise, used in dim light
